name: Eigenvector Computation via Cross-Product Averaging
definition: A robust method for computing eigenvectors of a symmetric 3x3 matrix when an eigenvalue has multiplicity one, using pairwise cross-products of the matrix columns to handle numerical precision issues.
summary: Eigenvector Computation via Cross-Product Averaging computes symmetric matrix eigenvectors by averaging pairwise column cross-products, offering robustness against numerical instability where standard solvers fail.
